package_session_events_rules.name: package_session_events_rules
package_session_events_rules.value: ("package_session_events"."kind" = 'deduction' and "package_session_events"."delta" = 1 and "package_session_events"."appointment_id" is not null) or ("package_session_events"."kind" = 'override' and length(btrim(coalesce("package_session_events"."reason", ''))) >= 3)

staff_schedules_break.name: staff_schedules_break
staff_schedules_break.value: ("staff_schedules"."break_start" is null and "staff_schedules"."break_end" is null) or ("staff_schedules"."break_start" < "staff_schedules"."break_end" and "staff_schedules"."break_start" >= "staff_schedules"."start_time" and "staff_schedules"."break_end" <= "staff_schedules"."end_time")
